label: 5. Rupee is in high spirits today.

lines.speaker: keuoaang
lines.text: Rupee is in high spirits today.

lines.speaker: braindead
lines.text: Probably 'cause she got another chance to talk about the Commander.

lines.speaker: ruruphee
lines.text: The only thing is, after that Couples Shopping video went viral,

lines.speaker: ruruphee
lines.text: there was no follow-up, and the series is pretty much dead.

lines.speaker: ruruphee
lines.text: Rupee should have seen the comments.

lines.speaker: ruruphee
lines.text: She's just paying the Commander to spend time with her. No way they're actually together.

lines.speaker: ruruphee
lines.text: I wonder how much she paid to pull this one off? I bet it was in the millions.

lines.speaker: ruruphee
lines.text: How could they say that? Rupee and her Sweetie are clearly in love.

lines.speaker: yesman
lines.text: We should focus on making this upcoming special as good as it can be.

lines.speaker: yesman
lines.text: By then, the rumor mill will have moved on to something else.
